detail.body:
## AI-Generated Details

Prepared with Codex from the author's GraphPP multiplexing design. This is a
new change, not an update of the stale DualPipeV placeholder draft.

Requires the new PyTorch Interleaved1F1BCombined API:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/201439

Multiplex independent forward/backward graphs without EP token chunks. Tag
source ownership explicitly; reuse the eager stack's native request/input
validation, tensor/mutation dependency builder and paging resource ordering.
Ready native launches yield priority to complementary source work, with waits
behind independent compute. Preserve original positional input order as ABI
dependencies, every operation binding and all outputs.

The existing pipeline runtime owns receives, unshards, sends, gradients and
callbacks. Enabling the default-off flag selects non-blocking HybridEP async
operations without dividing per-microbatch capacity. DeepEP and full-graph
Inductor remain outside scope; existing regional attention compilation stays.

Join terminal stash inputs through the existing group_start operation before
backward reload, avoiding calibration/residency input-output aliasing without
clones or schema changes. Explicit whole-step capture scope allows fixed PP
prefetch/residency decisions, with the partial-stage guard retained.

### Test Plan And Results

```bash
python -m pytest torchtitan/experiments/graph_trainer/tests/test_passes.py torchtitan/experiments/graph_trainer/tests/test_graph_pp_runner.py torchtitan/experiments/graph_trainer/tests/test_paged_stash.py -q -k 'not fsdp and not full_inductor and not dist_moe'
python -m pytest torchtitan/experiments/graph_trainer/tests/test_numerics.py -v -k 'hybridep_combined_pp_overlap_and_paging or hybridep_eager_overlap_and_paging or TestHybridEPContracts'
```

197 affected cases passed (one skip); all three real native/SPMD/PP integration
tests passed, including both strict ten-step PP comparisons with full pipeline
F/B CUDA capture/replay. Twenty-step checkpoint comparisons matched all293
tensors, non-tensor state and loss/gradient-norm values exactly.

Actual pre/post graphs preserve input/output ABI, all operations and paging
queue order, unique requests/keepalives, final-consumer commits and full row
capacity12288. All-rank built-in GPU traces confirm EP/GEMM, page/GEMM and
page/EP intersections; kernel counts are unchanged by EP-only scheduling.

One clean four-GB300 run on the six-layer DeepSeek V3 debug model, hidden256/
routed-intermediate4096, global4096/micro512, DPshard2/TP1/EP2/PP2, two local
stages/four microbatches, capacity4, strict seed42: EP-only56.094 ->52.452ms
(1.0694x throughput). Same-save no-page versus paging:51.836/51.256ms and
4.297/3.988GiB on rank2; reserved savings1.96-7.59% across ranks. Async EP-only
reserve was1.738 ->2.070GiB, not doubled capacity. No OOMs/allocation retries.

Twenty steps, throughput11-20; separate built-in profiles9-10/19-20; page64,
CUDA page factor2.1, no CPU spill. This is local debug-model evidence, not a
production-model, H100/multi-host or globally optimal scheduling claim.
Warmup/cooldown and exhausted complementary work remain unpaired.

Both H100 source/release CI selectors include the real PP test; their YAML/
shell/collection checks passed, but H100 execution has not run. Changed-code
lint passed; the unrelated video typing baseline remains unchanged.

@@ -215,6 +215,39 @@ Current limitations:
 - The token count must be even.
 - Additional overlap or sharding modes require their own loss and trace checks.
 
+### Pipeline Communication Overlap
+
+Pipeline overlap uses `Interleaved1F1BCombined` and graph multiplexing, not EP
+token chunking. The schedule adds one warmup forward, then pairs an independent
+forward and backward as an explicit `OVERLAP_F_B` action. Both actions' receives
+and parameter unshards precede the pair; normal send, gradient accumulation and
+reduction ownership remain in the existing pipeline schedule.
+
+```python
+config.parallelism.pipeline_parallel_schedule = "Interleaved1F1BCombined"
+config.compile.enable_graph_pp_comm_compute_overlap = True
+config.compile.ep_overlap.enabled = False
+config.compile.inductor_compilation = "regional"
+config.training.disable_cuda_graphs = False
+```
+
+Use non-blocking `HybridEPTokenDispatcher` capacity. Enabling the GraphPP pass
+selects explicit asynchronous native launches/waits without splitting tokens
+or dividing each microbatch's capacity. Configure `sac_and_paged_stash` to
+include page operations. Source graphs retain explicit forward/backward
+ownership when multiplexed. The pass validates native request/input lifetimes,
+preserves tensor/mutation and paging queue dependencies, launches ready
+communication early and postpones waits behind independent compute.
+Each native launch gives ready work in the opposite source graph priority,
+including its ready completion waits, instead of draining one source first.
+Full CUDA capture covers the entire pipeline forward/backward step, including every
+microbatch's distinct native routing state.
+
+The pass can be disabled with `compile.disable_passes =
+["graph_pp_comm_compute_overlap_pass"]` for a same-schedule comparison. Without
+combined actions, the requested overlap emits a warning. Full-graph Inductor
+and DeepEP are outside this feature's scope.
+
 ### Experimental AutoParallel Sharding
 
 GraphTrainer can use AutoParallel to solve SPMD placement for supported models,

+_GRAPH_PP_DIRECTION = "graph_pp_direction"

+def graph_pp_comm_compute_overlap_pass(
+    gm: fx.GraphModule, example_inputs: tuple | None = None
+) -> fx.GraphModule:
+    """Overlap explicitly owned F/B communications in a multiplexed graph.
+
+    Native exchanges retain their exact inputs through completion. Tensor and
+    mutation edges, plus the paging queue order, define the legal schedule.
+    Both source graphs form one scope: launches first, ready compute next,
+    completion waits last. Each native launch yields priority to ready work in
+    the opposite source graph, so neither source drains all its waits first.
+    No tokens or computation are split or duplicated.
+    """
+    del example_inputs
+    from torchtitan.experiments.graph_trainer.ep_overlap_pass import (
+        _collect_native_exchanges,
+        _graph_dependencies,
+        _paging_dependencies,
+        _prioritized_order,
+    )
+
+    exchanges = _collect_native_exchanges(gm.graph.nodes, context="GraphPP F/B pair")
+    deps = _graph_dependencies(gm)
+    launches, waits = _paging_dependencies(gm, deps)
+    source_nodes = {
+        direction: {
+            node
+            for node in gm.graph.nodes
+            if node.meta.get("custom", {}).get(_GRAPH_PP_DIRECTION) == direction
+        }
+        for direction in ("forward", "backward")
+    }
+    yield_to = {}
+    for exchange in exchanges:
+        direction = exchange.launch.meta.get("custom", {}).get(_GRAPH_PP_DIRECTION)
+        if direction not in ("forward", "backward") or direction != (
+            exchange.wait.meta.get("custom", {}).get(_GRAPH_PP_DIRECTION)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"GraphPP exchange {exchange.launch.name} lost its source F/B ownership"
+            )
+        launches.add(exchange.launch)
+        waits.add(exchange.wait)
+        yield_to[exchange.launch] = source_nodes[
+            "backward" if direction == "forward" else "forward"
+        ]
+    if not launches and not waits:
+        return gm
+    nodes = set(gm.graph.nodes)
+    planned = _prioritized_order(
+        deps,
+        order={node: index for index, node in enumerate(gm.graph.nodes)},
+        launches=launches,
+        waits=waits,
+        regions=[(nodes, nodes)],
+        yield_to=yield_to,
+    )
+    sequencing = {node: {previous} for previous, node in zip(planned, planned[1:])}
+    _stable_topological_sort(gm.graph, sequencing)
+    gm.graph.lint()
+    gm.recompile()
